name: battle_gato_press_action
doc: gato_press_action for the battle bakes: Crono talks to GATO and his song runs to its last box, as gato_press_action, from battle_gato_front (Marle at (137,164), the overworld's sparkle in OBJ tiles 0x05/0x15). The last wait is 99 frames so that one more A (`100:8,...`) boots the battle on the reference's frames: the battle loop's first iterations ($0027) at f376, f379, f382, f385, f387 from this state, as from gato_press_action.state (the battle's NMI-off boot crosses frames by its phase).
